# Support and questions

Honeymelon is free and open-source; it has no paid or account-based product support. [Open a GitHub issue](https://github.com/Thavarshan/honeymelon/issues/new/choose) if you need help or want to report a reproducible problem. Choose **Bug report** for defects, **Feature request** for suggestions, or a blank issue for a general support question. Search [existing issues](https://github.com/Thavarshan/honeymelon/issues) first.

Please include the exact Honeymelon version, desktop operating system and architecture (x64 or ARM64), installer/source, or browser and version. Distinguish the latest stable desktop release from the unsigned desktop beta and the browser beta; features differ across builds. Note whether legacy Comet is installed if this is an upgrade or migration question.

Never attach private media, secret tokens, sensitive local paths or unredacted logs. If you can reproduce a conversion failure with a generated sample file, share its reproduction steps instead.

**Security vulnerabilities** must be reported privately as described in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md), not in a public issue. Maintainers are volunteers; there is no guaranteed response time.
